messages:
maria: Heads up — PR #6172 is failing CI snapshots again on the merge-to-main run. Failing job: unit-tests/renderer-snapshots. Can someone take a quick look? cc @aj @ryan

aj: On it. I can reproduce locally. Snapshot mismatch in Button.test > "default render" — looks like attribute order changed.

aj: ```
-<button class="btn primary" data-testid="btn">OK</button>
+<button data-testid="btn" class="btn primary">OK</button>
```

ryan: We saw this before after a minor react/ts-jest bump. Could be nondeterministic prop iteration order. Which Node/jest versions are on CI?

aj: CI uses node 20, jest 29.5. I reran the job once and it passed, failed on the prior run. ci-bot shows 2/3 flakes for this PR.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Job unit-tests/renderer-snapshots failed (1/3 flaky). Rerun available.

sam: If it's only attribute order, options: update snapshots (quick) or add a serializer to stabilize prop ordering. What's preferable @maria?

maria: Prefer a fix if it's quick, otherwise update snapshots but add note. We want to avoid noisy snapshot churn.

aj: I'll try adding a stable serializer that sorts object keys in prettySnapshot. If I can't finish in ~30m I'll update snapshots and request approvals.

aj: Pushed a small patch that sorts keys in the serializer. Queueing a rerun now.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Rerun requested by aj — build #4821 queued.

karen: Heads up — current PR approvals: sam. We need one more reviewer to approve before merge.

ryan: I'll take a look once CI is green. Quick glance at the serializer change looks reasonable.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Build #4821 succeeded — all checks green.

maria: Nice work. @ryan please approve when you get a sec. @aj please add a changelog line saying "stabilize snapshot serializer to avoid prop-order flakes".

ryan: Approved — looks good.

maria: Merging now. Thanks everyone :tada:
